title: Wombat poop is shaped like cubes!
question: Did you know a wombat's poop is shaped like little cubes?
answer: Wombats are the only known mammals that make poop shaped like little cubes.
description: Wombats make poop shaped like little cubes, and no other known mammal does. Find out what a cube is, and why the cubes are so useful to people.

visual.what: A cute wombat in a bush, with a few tiny square cubes on the ground that zoom in with a sparkle. Big question mark above.

parts.text: Did you know a wombat's poop is shaped like little cubes?

visual.what: A wombat in an Australian eucalyptus forest at night, chewing grass and roots, with a small map pin on Australia.

parts.text: This is a wombat. It lives in Australia and eats grass, roots and other plants.

visual.what: A big dice-like cube turning slowly, six square sides highlighted one by one. Hùng in the corner chasing a rolling dice.

parts.text: A cube has six flat, square sides, like a dice.
I brought one! Oops, it rolled away.

visual.what: Many different animals in a row with round poop piles, and one wombat with a gold star and little cubes.

parts.text: Wombats are the only known mammals that make cube poop.
Yes, the only ones we know of.

visual.what: Simple cartoon cutaway of a wombat's tummy with a cube shape forming in the end part of the gut, water drops leaving it, labeled large intestine.

parts.text: The big intestine takes water out of leftover food waste. The cubes are made inside the wombat's body. Scientists are still studying exactly how.

visual.what: A scientist with a magnifying glass finds little cubes near a burrow, a smiling wombat peeking out. Hùng holding his nose, a bit worried.

parts.text: Cubes are handy. People spot them and know wombats live nearby. Scientists can even learn what a wombat ate.
I will let them do the looking.

visual.what: Huy, Hùng, Bối and Beo waving, a wombat behind them holding a tiny cube, Ask Huy channel logo and a follow button.

parts.text: Wow, a wombat's poop is made of little cubes!
Follow Ask Huy for more surprising facts!

facts.claim: Wombats are the only known mammals that excrete feces in a cubic shape.
Wombats live in Australian eucalypt forests and eat plants, roots and grasses.
Cubic feces let people know when wombat habitats are nearby, and show what the wombat may have eaten.
A cube has six square faces of the same size.
The large intestine takes water out of waste before it leaves the body.
Feces are the body's solid waste left over from eating food, and some scientists use feces to follow animal populations.
